Holly's - Your Life, Your Store

Company Description
Holly's Inc. is a mid-range chain of department stores owned by Mr. Farmani. It has been an innovative leader in the fashion industry for over 20 years. The company was founded by Mr. Farmani and his late brother Ernesto in 1990 as a clothing factory.
Since then, Holly's has developed into a global leader, presenting the latest fashion. In 1995 we established our first subsidiary in Canada, and others followed. Our commitment has always been to variety in our apparel, and to you, our loyal customers.

More Recent Corporate Highlights
  • 1998: Established Holly's U.S. subsidiary
  • 2001: Released our most successful clothing line - “Dress to Impress”
  • 2005: Started “Shop for A Cause” Annual Charity Event

Philosophy and Mission
The move from being a clothing factory to a department store has proved to be a very exciting part of our development. We have gained valuable experience and expertise, and we are proud to have grown into a multinational company. We started out as a small factory in Toronto, Canada, but we now feel we have a larger worldwide mission. Holly's philosophy has always been to be “the world's favourite for American style”. Over the years, this mission has kept us focused on making garments that not only exemplify our lifestyle, but enhance the ability to live it.

Look at the prompts below for some ideas about things you can include on your webpage.

Producing Website Content Describing a Company
The purpose of a company website is to advertise and give information to both existing and potential customers. A company website may include history, product information, as well as other features.
An About Us page highlights the company's description and mission, and provides information on current activities and products. Here's some language you can use to describe a company.

Using the Present Perfect and the Simple Past Tense

You use the Present Perfect to show a connection between the past and the present. If the situation is still relevant in the present, we often use for or since to say how long the situation has been true.

  • It has been an innovative leader in the fashion industry for over 20 years.
  • Since 1990, Holly's has developed into a global leader in the latest fashion designs.

Sometimes the speaker does not mention the exact time something took place. The Present Perfect is used because the action happened at an indefinite time in the past. In this case, we often use already, ever, never, always, yet or just.

  • Our commitment has always been to diversity, to our apparel and to you, our loyal customers.
  • We have already established Holly's US subsidiary.
Unlike the Present Perfect, the Simple Past refers to a specific event completed in the past and tell you when it happened.

• The company was founded by Giorgio Farmani and his late brother Ernesto Farmani in 1990.
  • In 1995 we established our first subsidiary in Canada.
